tools.vibestandup.enabled.description: Roll out the VibeStandup product surface (not proof of workspace entitlement).

addons.github.webhooks.description: Roll out GitHub webhook handling for add-ons.

vibestandup.multiTeam.enabled.description: Roll out multi-team UI/API beyond the free-plan single-team default. Enforce limits in Neon.

vibestandup.digestPublish.enabled.description: Show team-admin switches that post the standup summary to GitHub, Jira, and Linear. Each switch stays off until a team admin turns it on.

plans.catalog.description: Remote-readable copy of the workspace plan catalog (limits are authoritative in Neon when plans ship).
